messages:
Sam (Product): Heads-up: Hosted Streaming + Tool-Calling is GA at 09:00 PT today. Highlights: strict tool schema validation, ordered streaming chunks, and clearer error codes. Migration guide: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/stream-tool-ga :tada:

Iris (DevEx): Nice. When do SDK helpers land? Need examples for chunk parsing and tool result binding.

Sam (Product): SDK v1.2.0 published right after GA with ToolCallV1 helpers and streaming iterators. Backcompat shim is available but limited.

Dev (Eng): Rollout: canary 12% for 30m, 40% for 45m, then 100%. No forced cutover; we start a 60-day deprecation window for v0.

Nate (SRE): I'll provision dashboards for stream tail latency and schema-reject rates. PD alert if schema rejects >4% for 5m. Enabling extra traces for the first 12h.

Rhea (Legal): Quick reminder: if schemas carry PII keys, enable audit logging for Dedicated/Private by default; Hosted users get opt-in. I'll update the compliance note.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: stream-tool-ga @12% (deploy_id: dpl_2026_12_01_1905554321)

Sam (Product): Customer-facing blurb for release-notes: "GA: Streaming + Tool-Calling — stable schemas, improved streaming reliability, SDK helpers, 60-day deprecation for v0." Ill post once canary health is green.

Iris (DevEx): Quick curl example Ill add to quickstart:
```bash
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-tool \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","input":"check_events","tool_call":{"name":"events","schema":{"start":"string"}}}'
```

Dev (Eng): If any validator regressions occur ping me and Ill cut the rollback. Hotfix branch ready.

Nate (SRE): Canary health after 20m: all good, 0 schema errors. Monitoring hooks live.

Sam (Product): Thanks team 1. I'll pin the migration checklist and schedule reminders at 30d and 7d before v0 sunset.
